coordinate_system: EPSG:32647 with local offset stored in metadata.json

ground.method: robust local ground-plane fit in an annulus around the trunk

trunk_at_1_3_m.method: robust circle fit to the trunk cross-section

crown.method: 4 cm occupied-voxel crown component, robust 1st-to-99th percentile spread

limitations: The point cloud does not observe every side of every branch and leaf.
Leaf motion, occlusion and photogrammetric noise can bias crown dimensions.
No independent scale bar or survey checkpoint was available for validation.
The numerical uncertainty is larger than the circle-fit residual because scale and ground-height errors are systematic.
